info.name: FitMind API
info.description:
Complete test collection for the FitMind Backend API.

Covers all endpoints with happy-path and error scenarios:
- Authentication (signup, login, email verification, OTP, password reset)
- Profile management (create, read, update)
- AI Plan Generation (workout, nutrition)
- Workout Plans & Days & Exercises
- Nutrition Plans & Meals
- Tracking (foods, exercises, meal logs, workout logs, weight logs, scan, voice)
- Recommendation System (next meal by time, next workout, daily AI suggestion, progress report)

**Setup:** Import `FitMind_Environment.json` alongside this collection and select the "FitMind Local" environment before running.
